facts.activity_file: working in dust, darkness and weather restrictions

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: parking, chocking and restraint of equipment
positive communication before approaching mobile equipment
segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment

hazard_media: stored potential of an elevated component
facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: energy isolation failure on HT-9006

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an organisational factor.

Control POSITIVE_COMMUNICATION_BEFORE_APPROACH: the positive communication before approaching mobile equipment had been bypassed, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control PROXIMITY_DETECTION_AND_SEGREGATION: the segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Restore the positive communication before approaching mobile equipment on HT-9006 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in operating in reduced visibility, specifically working in dust, darkness and weather restrictions. HT-9006 (haul trucks) is in service for waste and ore haulage. The task proceeded during a planned shutdown while the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was not in place. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 14 September 2019 an incident occurred on HT-9006 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during a planned shutdown, releasing gravity energy held as suspended load.
